$comment: Interaction preferences, read at session start by every agent working in this repository. Committed on purpose: a preference that lives in one agent's context is re-learned by every sibling session, and re-learning it means asking again — which is WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.7 (Redundant Entry) violated in the least excusable way. See skills/folio-core/interaction-modality.md. The site's own settings control is a DIFFERENT thing: per-viewer, in localStorage, and it never reaches an agent.

litlfred@ibiblio.org.note: Very limited hand function. Every question is to be answerable by selecting: numbered options, four or fewer, the recommended one first and marked, and a stated default that the work proceeds on if no answer comes. Free text always available, never required.

default.note: Nobody has said anything: ordinary chat, with selectable options wherever there is a genuine choice. That is not a concession to anyone — it is a better question than an open one, and costs the user who would rather type nothing at all.
